products.name: iPhone 15 Pro
products.tagline: Titanium. So strong. So light. So Pro.
products.desc: The most advanced iPhone ever made. Featuring aerospace-grade titanium — the same alloy used by NASA for space missions — and the A17 Pro chip built on 3-nanometre technology.

products.name: AirPods Pro 2
products.desc: AirPods Pro feature Adaptive Audio — a new listening mode that seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency. The H2 chip enables next-level sound quality and personalised Spatial Audio.

products.name: Apple Watch S7
products.tagline: The watch that watches out for you.
products.desc: Apple Watch Series 7 features the largest and most advanced Always-On Retina display yet — with more screen area and thinner borders. The most crack-resistant front crystal on an Apple Watch.
